html:
Achievements are goals set by the game that players can try to reach to earn experience points, decorations, and diamonds. There are a total of 50 different types achievements, each able to be completed to the 3rd level, making 150 total achievements. It was introduced in Update 0.4 exclusively for Canada, although when the global version was released, it introduced all the content in previous updates for Canada.

Achievements are unlocked at experience level 6 and can be viewed via the farmhouse, whose appearance changes as one gets more achievements.

Farmhouse

Main article: Farmhouse

The appearance of the farmhouse changes as the player completes more and more achievements:

Rewards

Each category has three levels:

  • Completing the first level in a category results in a green ribbon and 1 diamond.
  • The second level gives players a blue ribbon and 2 or 5 diamonds.
  • The third level gives player a red ribbon and 3 or 10 diamonds.

Level completion also gives a certain amount of experience which depends on the category and level in question.

There are two exceptions:

  • Boat Score Hunter, which is one of the hardest achievements to get, gives 10 diamonds for level II and 50 diamonds for level III.
  • Derby Champ and Generous Neighbor do not give diamonds or experience points but special decorations and upgrades to the neighborhood area respectively.

Farm score

The farm score, which is displayed on the achievement board, is the total number of experience points the player has accumulated.
